note: Layout Section Classes is developer-facing: hook_layout_alter swaps any LayoutDefault layout that declares a 'classes:' key in its *.layouts.yml to Drupal\layout_section_classes\ClassyLayout. ClassyLayout renders a select per class group (keys: label, options[required], multiple, required, default, description, region_classes, attributes) and stores the chosen value in the section's layout config at additional.classes.<group>, appending it to the section wrapper #attributes['class'] at build. No configure route, permission, service, Drush, or own config schema. IMPORTANT: no core layout declares 'classes:', so the eval scripts rely on a permanently-installed namespaced fixture module web/modules/custom/lsc_fixture that ships a classy layout 'lsc_fixture_layout' (style group with options bg-primary/bg-muted); setup/reset ensure it is installed. Medium reads back which style class a live Layout Builder section carries; hard1 sets the bg-primary class on an existing classy section; hard2 adds a new lsc_fixture_layout section with a class. All are grounded in the entity_view_display node.lsc_demo.default Layout Builder section config.

evals.prompt: With the Layout Section Classes module, how do I make a Layout Builder layout offer CSS class dropdowns on its sections? What do I add to the layout definition and which plugin class takes over?
evals.expected_output: Add a 'classes:' key to the layout's definition in a *.layouts.yml. hook_layout_alter() then swaps the layout (if it uses core LayoutDefault) to Drupal\layout_section_classes\ClassyLayout, which renders a select per class group on the section configuration form.

evals.prompt: In the Layout Section Classes module, where are the classes a site builder selects for a section stored, and how do they end up on the rendered markup?
evals.expected_output: The chosen values are stored in the section's layout configuration under additional.classes.<group> (Section::getLayoutSettings()['additional']['classes']). At render, ClassyLayout::build() appends them to the section wrapper's #attributes['class'] (plus optional region_classes on regions and attributes on the section).

evals.prompt: In a Layout Section Classes 'classes:' definition, what keys can a class group declare, and which one is mandatory? How do you allow selecting more than one class?
evals.expected_output: A group can declare label, options (mandatory - value=>label; missing options throws), multiple, required, default, description, plus region_classes (extra classes onto named regions) and attributes (HTML attributes on the section). Set multiple: true to allow selecting several classes (stored as an array).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the 'LSC Demo' content type (lsc_demo) uses Layout Builder and its default display has one section whose style class was set via the Layout Section Classes module. Inspect the live layout configuration and state which CSS style class is applied to that section.
evals.expected_output: The section (layout lsc_fixture_layout) on node.lsc_demo.default has additional.classes.style = 'bg-muted'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the 'LSC Demo' content type (lsc_demo) uses Layout Builder and its default display has one section that offers selectable CSS classes via the Layout Section Classes module. Inspect the live layout configuration and give the layout plugin id that section uses.
evals.expected_output: The section on node.lsc_demo.default uses the lsc_fixture_layout layout (a ClassyLayout that declares a 'style' class group).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the lsc_demo content type's default Layout Builder display has a section using the lsc_fixture_layout layout, but no style class is selected. Using the Layout Section Classes mechanism, set that section's style class to 'bg-primary' and apply it to the live display.
evals.expected_output: On the node.lsc_demo.default entity_view_display, set the lsc_fixture_layout section's layout settings additional.classes.style to 'bg-primary' and save. Verify passes when that section's style equals 'bg-primary'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the lsc_demo content type's default Layout Builder display currently has only a plain one-column section. Add a new section that uses the lsc_fixture_layout layout and give it a non-empty style class (e.g. bg-primary), then apply it to the live display.
evals.expected_output: Append a Section('lsc_fixture_layout', ['additional' => ['classes' => ['style' => 'bg-primary']]]) to node.lsc_demo.default's layout_builder sections and save. Verify passes when a section uses lsc_fixture_layout with a non-empty additional.classes.style.
